introduce: Stand with your right hand on the wall. Bend your left leg and grasp your ankle or toes to bring your left calf close to your left thigh. Hold this position.
name: LEFT QUAD STRETCH WITH WALL

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please keep your upper body straight during the exercise.
Your lifted knee should always go straight down.
This exercise can stretch your quadriceps.

introduce: Stand with your left hand on the wall. Bend your right leg and grasp your ankle or toes to bring your right calf close to your right thigh. Hold this position.
name: RIGHT QUAD STRETCH WITH WALL

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please keep your upper body straight during the exercise.
Your lifted knee should always go straight down.
This exercise can stretch your quadriceps.

introduce: Lie on your back in front of a wall, place your feet on the wall, with knees slightly bent. Inhale and raise your arms overhead.\n\nPut your left ankle on your right thigh. Adjust the bend in your right leg until you feel a noticeable stretch in your left hip. Hold this position.
name: WALL PIGEON POSE LEFT

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please prepare a mat.
Breathe naturally.
Make sure your lower back is firmly against the mat and remains relaxed.
This exercise stretches your glutes.

introduce: Lie on your back in front of a wall, place your feet on the wall, with knees slightly bent. Inhale and raise your arms overhead.\n\nPut your right ankle on your left thigh. Adjust the bend in your left leg until you feel a noticeable stretch in your right hip. Hold this position.
name: WALL PIGEON POSE RIGHT

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please prepare a mat.
Breathe naturally.
Make sure your lower back is firmly against the mat and remains relaxed.
This exercise stretches your glutes.

introduce:
Lie on your back in front of a wall with your buttocks close to the wall. Place your legs against the wall and your hands on your abdomen.

As you exhale, bend your legs, open your knees to the sides, and put the soles of your feet together.

Slide your heels down to your groins. Inhale while maintaining loose hips.

Attempt a deeper stretch with each exhalation. Hold this position.
name: WALL BUTTERFLY POSE

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please prepare a mat.
Breathe in deeply and breathe out completely.
Make sure your lower back is firmly against the mat and remains relaxed.
You can feel a nice stretch in your groin.

introduce:
Lie on your back with knees bent 90 degrees and feet flat on the wall, hip-width apart. Rest arms by your sides. Lift your hips off the ground.

Open your knees, then bring them together.

Repeat the exercise.
name: WALL BUTT BRIDGE HOLD & HIP ABDUCTION

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Exhale as you open your knees, and inhale as you bring them together.
It helps to stretch your inner thigh muscles.
This is a good exercise for your hip abductors, gluteus maximus and hamstrings.
It also improves your sex life.

introduce:
Lie on your back with knees bent 90 degrees and feet flat on the wall, hip-width apart. Rest arms by your sides. Lift your hips off the ground.

Lift one leg at a time, extending it up the wall, then the other leg.

Return to the starting position and repeat the exercise.
name: WALL BUTT BRIDGE HOLD WALK

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Keep your hips lifted and core engaged.
Breathe steadily throughout.
This exercise strengthens the glutes, hamstrings and quadriceps.

introduce:
Lie on your back with knees bent 90 degrees and feet flat on the wall, hip-width apart. Put your arms straight over the top of your head.

Lift your upper body off the floor, then slowly go back to the starting position.

Repeat the exercise.
name: WALL LONG ARM CRUNCHES

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Focus on using your abdominal muscles.
Keep your neck in a neutral position by avoiding any forward tilting.
Keep your chin slightly tucked towards your chest.
Avoid using your arms to propel your body upwards.
Always keep your lower back on the floor.
Exhale when lifting, and inhale when lowering.
The exercise increases abdominal endurance.

introduce:
Lie on your back with knees bent 90 degrees and feet flat on the wall, hip-width apart. Rest arms by your sides.

Simultaneously lift your left leg and your upper body up by rotating your thoracic spine, reaching your right hand to touch your left ankle. Then, slowly lower to the starting position.

Repeat with the right leg and left hand.
name: WALL ALTERNATING TOE TOUCH

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Focus on rotating your thoracic spine.
Make sure your upper back leave the ground when touching your ankles.
Keep the other leg on the wall when lifting one leg up.
Exhale as you lift, inhale as you lower.
It develops the internal and external obliques.

introduce:
Stand sideways to the wall at arm's length. Press your right hand firmly into the wall for support.

Stretch your upper body sideways towards the wall, lifting your left arm overhead. Hold this position for 15 seconds.

Return to the starting position and repeat the exercise.
name: WALL STANDING SIDE BEND LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Engage your core muscles.
You should feel a gentle stretch on the right side of your body.
Breathe regularly.
Keep your supporting arm stable or stretch it gently when needed.
This workout stretches the spine and side abs.

introduce:
Stand sideways to the wall at arm's length. Press your left hand firmly into the wall for support.

Stretch your upper body sideways towards the wall, lifting your right arm overhead. Hold this position for 15 seconds.

Return to the starting position and repeat the exercise.
name: WALL STANDING SIDE BEND RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Engage your core muscles.
You should feel a gentle stretch on the left side of your body.
Breathe regularly.
Keep your supporting arm stable or stretch it gently when needed.
This workout stretches the spine and side abs.

introduce:
Stand facing the wall with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands touching the wall, about a forearm's length from it.

Lower into a squat until your thighs are parallel to the floor. Go up. Then, twist your body to the left side, and bring your back knee down to the floor.

Return to the starting position, switch sides, and then repeat.
name: WALL ROTATING LUNGE TO SUMO SQUAT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Keep your back straight and core engaged.
Avoid leaning too heavily on the wall.
It stretches the chest.
It strengthens the quadriceps.

introduce:
Stand sideways to the wall. Bend your right knee to place your right arm toward the ground, then straighten your right leg.

Gaze downward and extend your left arm against the wall. Lift your left leg off the ground, extending it as wide as possible.

Return to the starting position and repeat it.
name: WALL HALF MOON LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Make sure your right-hand fingertips are under your right shoulder.
Keep your gaze down for balance.
Keep your right leg as straight as possible.
Exhale as you lift the left leg, and inhale as you lower it down.
It strengthens the gluteus maximus.
It builds strength in your thighs.

introduce:
Stand sideways to the wall a few inches away. Bend your left knee to place your left arm toward the ground, then straighten your left leg.

Gaze downward and extend your right arm against the wall. Lift your right leg off the ground, extending it as wide as possible.

Return to the starting position and repeat it.
name: WALL HALF MOON RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Make sure your left-hand fingertips are under your left shoulder.
Keep your gaze down for balance.
Keep your left leg as straight as possible.
Exhale as you lift the right leg, and inhale as you lower it down.
It strengthens the gluteus maximus.
It builds strength in your thighs.

introduce:
Stand sideways to the wall and press your right forearm against it. Align your right elbow with your shoulder. Take a big step away from the wall and reach your left arm up.

Rotate your upper body to the right until your left hand touches the right waist.

Return to the starting position and repeat it.
name: WALL STANDING THORACIC LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Engage your core.
Avoid using momentum to twist the body.
It promotes the flexibility of the thoracic spine and abdominal strength.

introduce:
Stand sideways to the wall and press your left forearm against it. Align your left elbow with your shoulder. Take a big step away from the wall and reach your right arm up.

Rotate your upper body to the left until your right hand touches the left waist.

Return to the starting position and repeat it.
name: WALL STANDING THORACIC RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Engage your core.
Avoid using momentum to twist the body.
It promotes the flexibility of the thoracic spine and abdominal strength.
